name: Region title: clean, no bar
when: A region chapter starts: the region's name over the map scene that frames it (or over a calm shot). The white title rises letter by letter, the line under it types in.
anchor: The letters start rising at 0.22 s and are in at 0.73 s: start the scene just before the voice names the region.

vars.title: the region's name, in capitals as validated ("VICE CITY"); 13 characters at most
vars.sub: the line under it, typed one character a frame (validated in spaced capitals: "THE SUN AND FUN CAPITAL OF AMERICA"); empty = none
vars.dim: true (default) = the template brings its own left dim, in from 0 s and out 0.15 s after `out`; false when the scene under it already dims the left side, as the map chapter does under its postcard (the validated layering: dim, then postcard, then title)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the title starts to leave (at least 2.0). The scene ends 0.45 s later

changed: The title layer only: the map, its camera, the region outline, the flash, the postcard and the left dim under the postcard are the map scene's. The template can bring that left dim itself (`dim`, on by default) so the title reads on any map or shot; when it does, the dim leaves in 0.3 s instead of 0.35 s (exit 0.3 s at most), and it sits above whatever the scene under it shows.
